label: Every invariant two-way giver HAS_WILL_1, by the restricted Theta 5 principle
description: Argument C, the Theta 5 bridge with the weakest Theta 5 version that suffices (DNP_inv, restricted to invariant sources). Not a transcription. Establishes no premise. With excluded middle DNP_inv is exactly the denial of CHANCE_3 at invariant sources (controls, law 11), so this route discriminates will from chance only as far as DNP_inv is independently warranted; its omission model is the chance rival.
